diagnosis: DeviceTelemetryResource adds a custom export_log view routed under /api/v1/telemetry/<pk>/export/. Although it calls self.is_authenticated(request), it retrieves IndustrialDeviceLog directly by pk from kwargs['pk'] without checking that the associated device belongs to request.user.facility. Any authenticated contractor can dump sensitive firmware telemetry and operational logs from equipment at unauthorized industrial sites.
